rules.rationale: Names a control and describes defeating it — that is a bypass procedure, not a signature.
rules.compliant_alternative: Describe the OBSERVABLE the bypass produces (e.g. 'field-combination implausibility with a high field-population score').

rules.rationale: Reads as INSTRUCTION rather than as signature. The archive describes shapes, not recipes.
rules.compliant_alternative: State the kill-chain STAGE NAMES and the observables each stage produces.

rules.rationale: Executable code inside an archive entry.
rules.compliant_alternative: Remove the code. A detector consumes distributions and field co-occurrences, not programs.

rules.rationale: Matches a real-scheme IIN/BIN range and card-number length. Our identifiers are drawn from reserved non-routable prefixes and are deliberately non-Luhn-valid.
Matches a plausible Indian mobile number. No real PII, ever.
rules.compliant_alternative: Use a synthetic handle from the reserved space; mobile numbers are not modelled at all.

rules.rationale: Matches a plausible IFSC code shape. No real institutional identifiers.
rules.compliant_alternative: Use the synthetic PSP ids (PSPnnn) the world builder generates.

rules.rationale: An enumeration PROCEDURE. Card testing is in the taxonomy as a signature; the procedure is not.
rules.compliant_alternative: Describe the observable: distinct-PAN-per-terminal within tight BIN prefixes, near-uniform micro-amounts, decline-reason concentration.

rules.rationale: Vendor- or scheme-named vulnerability claim. We make no claims about any named product's security.
rules.compliant_alternative: Describe the mechanism generically and mark the specifics [VERIFY].

rules.rationale: Persuasive scam copy / smishing template. We generate template FAMILIES with labelled generators, never persuasion.
rules.compliant_alternative: The detector needs the DISTRIBUTIONAL signature (near-duplicate embedding clusters, n-gram unlikelihood, metadata uniformity), not the content.

rules.rationale: Describes building a deepfake or voice-cloning capability. We build none of that.
rules.compliant_alternative: Model the OBSERVABLE COHORT STATISTIC instead: device-model entropy collapse, ASN reuse, name n-gram unlikelihood, onboarding-to-first-credit latency.
Credential values are never content. Reference the schema field name instead.

rules.rationale: A plausible Aadhaar number shape. No real or realistic national identifiers.
rules.compliant_alternative: AePS is modelled by terminal-level population statistics only; no identity numbers exist in the schema.

limits: PATTERN-BASED. It will miss paraphrase. It is a FLOOR UNDER human review, not a substitute for it. Deliberately crude, because a crude filter that fails the build is more trustworthy than a clever one that fails silently.
why_published: A filter whose output you cannot see is an assertion. A log showing what was proposed and refused demonstrates the boundary was enforced during the build, and lets a reviewer disagree with a specific decision rather than with our self-description.
